mobbin:07782c2f-36d1-44fb-b1a5-d9771b478.summary: Host starts a meeting from the phone, grants mic access, admits a waiting-room participant, then runs the live session with mute/unmute and a participant count.
steps: Meetings hub — New Meeting / Join / Schedule
Start a Meeting — Video On + PMI toggles
Mic permission dialog — Join Audio, Participants 1
Live toolbar — Mute / Stop Video / Participants 1
Waiting room banner — View / Admit Dexter Lee
Participant tile — connecting to audio status
Video tile — muted mic badge on Dexter Lee
Scrolled toolbar — Participants / Chat / Share / More
steal: Waiting-room toast with primary Admit + secondary View (step 5) — admit who enters without opening a full roster.
Participants badge count on the toolbar (steps 4, 8–9) — glanceable who-is-in-session.
Explicit Mute vs muted-slash state on toolbar and on remote tile (steps 4, 7–8) — live/muted for intercom analog.
Connecting-to-audio status before they can hear you (step 6) — avoids talking into a dead channel.
avoid: Calling this recording-control — no record start/stop, red REC, or recording lock screen appears in any step.
mobbin:07782c2f-36d1-44fb-b1a5-d9771b478.fit: Mobile wins for in-room admit + mute while walking; does not show recording control so it does not replace SRV record — use for learner-tagging / intercom cues only.
